column1: # ESP32-P4 (Family mruby Modern) - 16MB flash
# factory was 6M until the Spinel runtime was moved to the latest upstream
# (doc/spinel_upstream_ext/): the image grew past it by about 110 KB
# point where it already had only 5% spare. It went to 7M then
# moved from 0x610000 to 0x710000 and the last 960K of the flash left unused.
# mruby-checkpoint (doc/checkpoint F6) took the 7M image to 2% spare (the
# baseline table alone is about 264 KB). factory now takes the unused 960K as
# 0x800000 to the end of the 16MB flash (0x1000000) until F4 below.
# A partition-table change cannot ship as an app-only update: it needs a full
# flash (bootloader + table + app + storage)
# flash:app` onto a board still carrying an older table writes an image that
# table cannot hold
column2: or runs with storage at the old offset.
